prompt: Design a running app for office workers who want to build a habit

directions.name: Race bib
directions.line: Huge number, pin holes, a tear-off stub

directions.name: Track lane
directions.line: Red clay track, today you run lane 5

directions.name: Morning paper
directions.line: Each day's plan is a front page

questions.why: Big number, red top band and pin holes: anyone who has run a race recognises it
The giant 05 on the home screen; every finished run becomes a torn-off stub
Next to the first AI draft, colour, type and layout skeleton are all different
The paper shader makes the bib feel like Tyvek, but it is subtle and the screen still works without it
The big numbers read instantly; secondary text is grey with enough contrast
